_comment: One entry per collection cover. This file is the single source of truth:
render.mjs lays the card out from it and backgrounds.ps1 turns `bg` into the
art prompt, so the words on a poster and the picture behind them cannot drift
Counts and runtimes come from verify_fresh/catalog.json -- the platform's own
listing -- not from the exported folders, which fill up over hours while an
export runs and would put a different number on the poster each time.
`out` is relative to `root` and mirrors the catalog: <category>/<sub>/<collection>
where a sub-category exists. On a poster `en` has to fit the narrower layout,
so it stays under about 22 monospaced characters.
_naming: Kept here rather than in the scripts on purpose. Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes a .ps1 file
without a BOM as ANSI, so a Chinese literal in a script is read as mojibake and creates a
directory nobody will find -- which is what `封面` did before these two fields existed.
Every .ps1 here is ASCII-only and reads its Chinese from this file, which is opened as UTF-8.
